AML_definition: Model.csv OncotreePrimaryDisease == Acute Myeloid Leukemia, intersected with CRISPRGeneDependency

candidate_family.multiple_testing: one BH correction across all evaluable members of the 533-candidate family
candidate_family.test: two-sided Spearman correlation: frozen pathway axis vs CRISPR dependency probability

expression_scoring.transformation: within-model percentile ranks over mapped AML-GraphRx gene universe

focused_panel.definition: 33 previously locked DEPMAP_HIGH_CONFIDENCE_SUPPORT genes from R5DM
focused_panel.inference: reuse full-533-family BH q values; do NOT recompute a 33-gene FDR
focused_panel.role: focused descriptive subset of the full family

forbidden: reselect genes based on R8F results
change frozen pathway membership or weights
drop AML models because of unfavorable dependency association
use a smaller focused-panel FDR to create significance
interpret CRISPR dependency as drug sensitivity
